summary: Verified iter33 fix: Request Intake (PharmacyIntake) now searches BOTH directory + verified portal patients via /internal/patient-lookup, loads snapshot via /internal/patient-snapshot/{id} (falls back to db.patients when no directory record) and submits pharmacy-rx with EITHER directory_id OR patient_id. Backend pytest: 6/6 passed. UI e2e: portal-only Maria Lopez (PIN 9251, DIRECTORY STATUS = PORTAL_PATIENT) fully searchable, snapshot loads with source=portal + patient_id set + directory_id null, and intake submission creates RX-000030 (Pharmacy, patient_name 'Lopez, Maria', status Waiting for Physician) in the Rx queue. Directory regression: 'smith' returns SMITH, Salvador (directory), snapshot source=directory with directory_id, intake submit creates RX-000029 with patient_name 'SMITH, Salvador' also Waiting for Physician. Both flows redirect to /internal/rx and display the new items immediately with success toast 'Sent to physician Rx queue.'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::patient_snapshot: portal branch returns 'directory_id': p.get('matched_directory_id') — for a portal patient linked to a directory record this will be non-null; the request states 'directory_id null' for portal-only. Current preview data has Maria Lopez with no matched_directory_id, so behavior matches spec, but consider adding an assertion/log path so a portal patient that DOES have a matched_directory_id doesn't accidentally get double-persisted (both directory_id and patient_id set) on pharmacy-rx submit — the frontend will send both.

PharmacyIntake.jsx::submit sends BOTH snap.directory_id and snap.patient_id. Backend then prefers directory_id when set. Consider making this preference explicit in a helper or documenting it so future callers don't get surprised (e.g. portal patient whose directory_id becomes set later).
test_credentials: staff@visita.demo / Staff2026! (identifier login on /signin) — verified working.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 pharmacy Rx test rows this iteration: RX-000030 (portal-only Maria Lopez, TEST_UI_PortalPharm) and RX-000029 (directory SMITH Salvador, TEST_UI_DirPharm). Prior pytest also created TEST_PortalPharmacy / TEST_DirectoryPharmacy rows (RX-000028/029 range). All non-destructive; no reseed/reset performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route path is /internal/pharmacy-intake (not /internal/rx/intake). Portal-only Maria Lopez has VISITA PIN 9251 and directory_status label 'PORTAL_PATIENT' in the snapshot side panel. The Rx queue at /internal/rx shows both PHARMACY and PATIENT source rows; pharmacy intake items show as source=PHARMACY with 'Waiting for Physician' status. Cumulative TEST_ pharmacy Rx rows in queue — safe to leave for regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; the previously reported search miss for portal-only verified patients is fully resolved. patient_snapshot correctly falls back to db.patients, and create_pharmacy_rx correctly resolves via patient_id when directory_id is absent.
